The '''Icefall Plains''' was a large frozen region on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. During the [[Galactic War]], it contained a strong [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] presence, including their [[Dorn Base|main base]] of operations. The plains were mostly inhabited by [[Ice Cat]]s, [[Icetromper/Legends|icetrompers]] and [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntauns]].
